notes:
Profile: mid-market SaaS (CX/product messaging) building an in-app assistant and admin agent for customers and support staff. Evaluate Hosted API first to validate UX and prompt quality, then move to Dedicated for guaranteed latency/cost once traffic >50k sessions/month.
POC flow:
- Week 0: quick integration on Hosted (streaming + tool-calls) using canonical prompt set (150 prompts covering happy/path edge cases).
- Week 1-2: workload replay, latency harness (internal), compare Redwood hosted vs baseline (internal open-source runtime).
- Week 3-6: Dedicated trial (reserved slice) to measure tail latency, cost per session, and stability under 2k concurrent sessions.
SLOs & perf targets (customer-specified):
- Initial streaming chunk <= 180ms median for short greetings (<=20 tokens).
- Average per-token streaming latency target ~35-50ms for steady-state.
- End-to-end agent action (incl. tool call to search/FS/API) 95th <= 500ms; 99th <= 850ms.
- Deterministic tool-selection + signed audit trail for all tool calls.
Prompt & eval policy needs:
- Will gate every rollout with regression evals on canonical prompt set + 20 new "real-world" logs sampled weekly.
- Require automatic rollback and canary A/B hooks: 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% ramp with automated quality checks at each step.
- Latency-driven optimizations allowed (quantization, shorter context) but must protect top-10 prompts where quality drop is unacceptable. Quote from Head of Eng (Nora Patel): "We will trade a few tokens of output fidelity if it keeps the assistant snappy — but no regressions on critical flows."
Security & compliance notes: SSO/SAML required, KMS for customer keys, audit logs for tool calls, EU residency for EU customers.
Open questions / blockers logged in CRM:
- Exact Dedicated unit pricing at 99th-tail SLO targets.
- How prompt-eval gating integrates with CI (GitHub Actions preferred).
- Replayability: can we replay production traces with identical tool-call ordering?
